content:
Renee (Finance): Heads up — Partner payout for reseller 'EdgeScale' is ~22% lower this month. Their statement shows promo discount applied twice (discount line + promo rebate line).
Cal (Billing Ops): Can you paste the invoice lines?
Renee (Finance): Snippet from partner statement: 
```
line 7: RWINF-STD qty 100 $10,000
line 8: EDGE_PROMO_2028-03 discount -$2,000
line 9: EDGE_PROMO_2028-03 rebate -$2,000
line 10: partner_commission 20% -$1,200
```
marketplace-bot: Marketplace manifest deploy 2028-03-10T01:15:00Z triggered promo flag EDGE_PROMO_2028-03 for cohort: edge-beta-resellers.
Ben (Product): That promo was an experiment toggled for internal beta. It shouldn't have been enabled for EdgeScale. Looks like the experiment targeting rule matched their reseller tag.
Lina (Partner Success): EdgeScale has already escalated — they need corrected payout schedule. They claim the double discount reduced their commission.
Cal (Billing Ops): Root cause: billing transform applied both promo discount (pricing_rules) and export later added rebate aggregation. I can run a ledger diff to confirm how many invoices affected. Quick SQL: `SELECT reseller_id, invoice_id, SUM(amount) FROM partner_statements WHERE promo_code='EDGE_PROMO_2028-03' GROUP BY reseller_id, invoice_id;`
Asha (Revenue Ops): We need exposure numbers and decide provisional payout policy. If delta <= $10k per partner, Product approves immediate correction as contra-revenue; otherwise FP&A sign-off.
Renee (Finance): Initial grep: 5 resellers affected, total partner shortfall $14,600. EdgeScale shortfall $6,400.
marketplace-bot: Audit log: feature-flag-service toggled EDGE_PROMO_2028-03 -> true for tag=edge-beta-resellers at 2028-03-10T01:10:22Z by deploy pipeline #482.
Ben (Product): I rolled back the flag at 2028-03-10T02:00:00Z. Need billing to regenerate partner statements for 03/01-03/10 window.
Cal (Billing Ops): Plan: 1) run regen for affected dates; 2) produce CSV with impacted invoices; 3) issue credit memos or provisional payouts for resellers <= $10k (auto-approve). For >$10k we'll loop FP&A.
Lina (Partner Success): I'll inform partners that we're issuing corrected statements and provisional payouts where applicable. Ask them to sign quick ack for payout.
Asha (Revenue Ops): Accounting treatment: provisional payouts logged as contra-revenue pending reconciliation. Send ledger entries to me.
Renee (Finance): Approve provisional payouts up to $10k. EdgeScale ($6.4k) can proceed once CSV is in sheet. Others >$10k need Nina (FP&A) approval.
Cal (Billing Ops): CSV uploaded: https://redwood.app/sheets/marketplace-experiment-2028 sheet "edge-promo-doubles". Columns: reseller_id, invoice_id, invoice_date, promo_line_id, rebate_line_id, amount_delta, suggested_action.
marketplace-bot: Support ticket OPENED with feature-flag-service team -> FF-9999.
Ben (Product): I'll add a post-mortem and change request to add a hard-stop for experiment targeting that intersects partner exports.
Lina (Partner Success): EdgeScale ack'd provisional payout note and will sign today.
Renee (Finance): Action list: @Cal regen + CSV, @Lina get partner ack, @Ben post-mortem and change request, @Asha log accounting entries, @Renee prepare credit memos. Marking P1 until payouts issued. :rotating_light:
Cal (Billing Ops): ETA regen + CSV: 90 mins. Will post when done.
Renee (Finance): Thanks — short updates only in thread for audit trail.
